help.intro: One click to understand the page.
help.refresh: Refresh open pages after installing or updating the extension.
help.translateHelp: Translate using your saved languages and service, or click the extension icon in the browser toolbar.
help.changeLanguageHelp: Open the floating panel to choose source and target languages and a service.
help.selectionHelp: Select text with the mouse or keyboard, pause, then click the pink dot. Other triggers include an icon, automatic translation, or a modifier key. Copy results from the popup; press Escape or click outside to close.
help.hoverHelp: Off by default. Hold Ctrl over foreign-language text to translate or restore one paragraph. You can change the trigger and action in settings. Simplified and Traditional Chinese are skipped.
help.restoreHelp: Click the pink button or green check again to remove translations, including while translation is running.
help.supported: Text in the main document is supported. Forms, code, editable areas, and hidden content are skipped. Browser internal pages, extension stores, PDFs, image text, iframes, and Shadow DOM content are not supported yet.
help.privacy: Page, selection, and hover translation send the relevant text to your chosen service. Settings and translations are stored locally; successful translations are kept for up to 7 days and evicted when the cache is full. You can clear the cache manually. API keys are encrypted and never exposed to web pages.

services.microsoftHelp: Uses Microsoft Edge web translation with native batching and automatic language detection. No account or API key required.
services.googleHelp: Uses Google web translation with automatic language detection. Your network must be able to access Google Translate.
services.customOpenaiHelp: Supports OpenAI Chat Completions compatible services such as Ollama, LM Studio, or your own proxy. Enter the endpoint and installed model name. Leave the API key blank when authentication is not required.
services.customClaudeHelp: Claude Messages compatible API with its own endpoint, model, and key. Supports internal proxies; leave the key blank if authentication is not required.
rules.xHelp: Translate posts, replies, and articles. Preserve mentions and emoji.
rules.redditHelp: Translate post titles, text, comments, and the right sidebar. Left sidebar regions are optional.
rules.youtubeHelp: Translate search results, video descriptions, and comments. Home and sidebar videos are optional. Preserve channel names and navigation.
rules.githubHelp: Translate search results, issue and pull request titles, commit messages and times, Markdown, and About. Search filters and sidebar details are optional; controls, repository headers, list metadata, filenames, and topic tags stay unchanged.
rules.googleHelp: Translate search results, AI Overview content, and the right sidebar. Preserve search categories, tools, and the search box.
rules.githubFiltersHelp: Search types, languages, and filter names. Off by default; preserve counts.
rules.translateInlineLinks: Translate link text and preserve links and icons
rules.inlineFormatHelp: Optional. Keep bold, italic and highlighted text. Inline code stays unchanged.
rules.inlinePreserveHelp: Optional. Keep citation pills with real links, source names and icons unchanged.
rules.renderedTextHelp: Optional. Read the text displayed in a component's open Shadow DOM instead of its fallback text.
rules.inlineLinkHelp: Optional. Keep matching link labels, icons, and click behavior in translations.
rules.youtubeHomeHelp: Home video titles. On by default.
rules.youtubeRelatedHelp: Recommended video titles on watch pages. On by default.
